name: Fumiha Tanaka
reason: Her work is mainly clinical herbalism and health-framed healing packages (diet, herb and flower-essence protocols; testimonials and her own story centred on eczema, digestion, depression and surgery), so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule; her only other dated offering, the online Venus and Inanna journey with Susan DeRyder, began on 29 Oct 2026, and she has no books, videos or free resources. Her Kripalu programme (Moving From Shadow into Light, 20 to 23 Dec 2026) is co-led with Aki Hirata Quetzalyolotzin (rank 41).
